brief:
Shehab Wire reported that Israeli occupation forces shot dead a Lebanese civilian as military operations continue in the region. The incident marks another casualty amid escalating cross-border tensions.

Details about the circumstances of the killing and the identity of the victim were not immediately available. The death occurred as Israeli forces maintain operations affecting Lebanese territory and communities near the border.

title: Israeli forces kill Lebanese civilian amid ongoing hostilities
